New here? How WCA records work
Every match on a WCA card counts toward exactly one division. The winner earns a Win — and a contender point if they're not the champion. Three points makes them #1 Contender and earns a title shot; taking the shot resets their points, win or lose. Whoever gets pinned, tapped out, or eliminated takes the Loss. Anyone else on the losing end who never took the fall gets a No-Win — it doesn't count against their record. Champions sit at the top of their division until they lose the belt, and every record, form box, and title change updates automatically after each show. Tap any name to open their profile and see their match-by-match history. Records, rankings and contender points count from WCA 34 on, when the current era began. Earlier shows are still on Past Events and the Timeline, they just don't count.
# = rank in division = win rate = social handles WDLN = last 5 (newest left · W win, D draw, L loss, N no-win) W–D–L–NW = total record (Wins–Draws–Losses–No Wins) = contender point, glowing when earned, an empty ring when not (3 = #1 contender)

Join the Roster

Apply to become an official WCA wrestler. Sign-ups are reviewed personally — submit a serious pro-wrestling character (representing you or fully original) and it gets created or imported into WWE 2K25, balanced to a hard cap of 85 overall, then added to the roster.

Taken seriously. Characters must read as legit pro wrestlers. Influences are welcome with a clear wrestling spin — no joke gimmicks.
85 OVR cap. Every wrestler is balanced to 85 overall or lower. The detail you give helps keep that fair.
How it works. You apply → I review → I create/import & balance the CAW → you debut on the roster.
WCA runs on PC. WWE 2K25/2K26 has no full cross-platform sharing — a CAW made on Xbox Series X|S or PS5 can't be imported to PC. So if your existing character is on a current-gen console, your share code won't work for us. No problem: just fill out the application as a new creation with as much detail as you can, and I'll rebuild it from scratch on PC. Only CAWs already on PC can be imported directly.
